neighbours.label: the comma after three leading digits in a count ('500,000'), as against two leading digits
fire: The state now has 350,000 registered voters.
About 720,000 tourists visit the island each year.
The firm shipped 480,000 units last spring.
Roughly 260,000 people live along the river.
The fund paid out 910,000 claims in a decade.
Some 170,000 homes lost power in the storm.

notes: The opposite pole's top peaks are commas after one or two leading digits. ' million' on the card (0.15 and below in probes) is not covered.
